Results.ReviewText: We have one at our Home in Maine and just bought one for our Winter home in Florida. We are Seniors and have had many other Brands over the years. This by far is the VERY BEST.
Results.Title: The Best

Results.ReviewText: Does everything it was claimed to do, love to cook on it.
Results.Title: Very nice grill

Results.UserLocation: Deep in the heart of Texas
Results.ReviewText: Our new Weber grill is excellent quality. I purchased it for Christmas as "a present to us" and my wife loves it. Of course, I got the privilige of assembling it and although the instructions did leave a bit for the user to figure out, I was amazed at the precision of the manufacture of the various pieces.
Results.Title: Some assembly required

Results.ReviewText: I purchased this grill to replace a 15 yr. old webber that served me well. The first time I used it the flame went out twice ( No wind and  plenty of fuel. I also had trouble maintaining a constant temp.) It took me twice as long for my food to cook.
Results.Title: Poor performance.

Results.ReviewText: My weber grill of 20 yrs gave ot soI purchesed a new one. It's great, easy to use.
Results.Title: Last one only lasted 20yrs

Results.ReviewText: Great Grill, except the location of the gas cylinder is worse than it ever was (inside the cabinet). It is very hard to lift up a full cylinder and lift it up and then go horizontal to try and hang the it on the hanger. I can't lift it that far. A very Dumb location. My previous Weber  cylinder was hung on the outside of the cabinet. If I had known how difficult it is, this would have caused a no sale. I had to have my muscular son lift it in and it was not easy.
Results.Title: A great grill but a bad design for the Cyl. clip

Results.ReviewText: Our last Weber grill lasted over 20 years, granted we replaced various parts.  But 2020 was time for a new one - only a Weber,  We like this one, with 4 wheels,it is easier to maneuver.  We like the size of it, as our family household has shrunk from then to now.
Results.Title: Our New Weber

Results.ReviewText: It’s a quality product - all parts are good quality. The lighting feature is excellent and works very well. The grill and flavor grates are easy to clean. I highly recommend. I’m looking at a rotisserie attachment. It’s much nicer to use the grill than my electric stove - yes, I use it that much, even in the northeast during winter.
Results.Title: I LOVE the spirit e-210 grill

Results.ReviewText: I bought my Sprit E210 some 7 or 8 years ago and used it about once per week. I do clean it regularly, but am not over the board on it. About 2 years ago I contacted Weber about replacing some parts. I sent pictures and ended up getting the burner tubes under warranty. I paid for the flavor bars and knobs. Before buying this unit gas grills were throw away units. Use it for 4 to 5 years then throw them away. After owning a Weber I am a believer that you can keep the frame and replace a few parts every now and then.
Results.Title: Very Reliable Gas Grill

Results.ReviewText: Recieved this as a Christmas present. Meets all my expectations. I don't trust any other makes. I have previously owned a Weber so I know this one won't let me down.
Results.Title: Wonderful!

Results.ReviewText: The moment I opened the box, you know this was different.  The packaging is youthful and the build quality is excellent.  Everything was perfect.  Thank you!
Results.Title: Superior Quality

Results.ReviewText: Have used the E320 several times and find it easy to operate and to control the temperature. The unit takes up little space on my deck and is easy to move.
Results.Title: Good size for family use.

Results.ReviewText:
Great compact grill with even heat, folding sides, and inside tank storage location.
Tank hook design is terrible for replacing a full 20 gal tank inside the cabinet.
Burner tents rust and burn thru prematurely.
Results.Title: Quality grill

Results.ReviewText:
First time Weber owner...I didn't realize how much better this would turn out to be
HAPPY with my purchase
Results.Title: consistant excellence

Results.ReviewText: Have had grill for 3 months and exactly what needed for small patio.  Is all as advertised and easy to use with good features and side shelves.
Results.Title: Great Size

Results.ReviewText: Best grill I’ve ever owned would highly recommend love the features
Results.Title: Love the size

Results.ReviewText: Very efficient and cooks evenly.  Great on gas.  My only negative is that when I reach up (without looking) to close the lid, I grab the hot cover rather than the handle.  Still used to using the old genesis silver we had before.
Results.Title: perfect for 2

Results.ReviewText: In this day and age of declining quality and rising prices it was shocking to see the quality of this Weber grill. From the fit and finish of all the parts, to the assembly process which I performed, to the manner in which the whole grill was packaged in its box, this is an amazing, still made in America product. I simply cannot say anything negative about this grill. I assembled the grill with a single screw driver and one socket wrench. For our purposes this grill made the most sense. We live in a condo and so I store it in our garage. The four casters makes moving the grill effortless and the collapsable shelves are perfect space savers. Buy this grill and you will not be disappointed. Full stop.
Results.Title: Unbelievable Build Quality

Results.ReviewText: I have been using my grill for6 weeks and I am very pleased.  I am impressed how fast it gets up to grilling temperature with only 2 burners.  Ample room to barbecue more than 6 burgers.  I have grilled fish , steak , sausages and burgers successfully.  I would recommend this product with no hesitation.
Results.Title: Excellent compact BBQ

Results.ReviewText: DOES NOT COOK EVENLY, MY LAST GRILL HAD INFRA RED TECHNOLOGY,DID A MUCH BETTER JOB
Results.Title: NOT IMPRESSED

Photos.Caption: Need inside dimensions just above burners.

Results.ReviewText: Rotisseried a 21.5 lb turkey in one of these on Thanksgiving. Worked great but would like to know the dimensions of a pan that would fit above the burners with the grating and all removed. I want to collect drippings in a non- aluminum pan so it won't burn up during cooking.
Results.Title: Larger than it seems.

Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill about a month now. Used it 3 times. Best grill ever owned. Cost a little more than what I’ve paid for other grill, but it’s it far more sturdy. I grilled chops and steaks so far, can not believe how much better the meat taste. Love it.
Results.Title: Love it

Results.ReviewText: My wife gave me this grill for my birthday.  It is a perfect fit on our lanai.  We use a natural gas connection so finding grills can be tough.  She found this one and it is great. We do a lot of grilling and roasting and the size it great and it is easy to control the temperature.  I look forward to many great years with this grill
Results.Title: Perfect fit

Results.ReviewText: This is my 3rd Weber spirit grill after secveral moves. Wonderful for grilling and cooking. Trouble with the electronic igniter that I'm not happy with. Doesn't work half of the time. Previous igniters on my other Weber Spirits worked very time.
Results.Title: Excellent grill

Results.ReviewText: I love the way it grills, easy to clean and replace the tank
Results.Title: Excellent grill for the value

Results.ReviewText: I used this grill model or 3 years at a rental house and had to buy my own when I purchased my New home.  It is a small size but I discovered it will handle fairly large crowds due to quality and performance grilling.
Results.Title: Small Compact with Quality

Results.ReviewText: I have had this grill for about 4 months and I woould say it is the best grill I have ever owned.  It's not huge so it doesn't take up as much room on the deck.  It heats up rapidly and you can get cooking quicker.  Cooks evenly and creates good flavor. Good warrantly.
Results.Title: Best grill

Results.ReviewText: I have 2 houses and bought my first one of these 2 years ago (now I have 2). I love the simplicity and temperature uniformity. I like the drop down side tables because we are in an open area and the wind can get under the stationary tables and literally flip the grill. Additionally I like the tank being hidden.
Results.Title: Love this grill

Results.ReviewText: Very happy with this grill.  Great features.  Easy to use.
Results.Title: Cooks fast

Results.ReviewText:
Easy assembly. Cooks great. Looks sharp. 
Good value.
Results.Title: Perfect for two people.

Results.ReviewText: This is our first Weber grill and we live it!! Heats very evenly and cleans up easily
Results.Title: Love it!

Results.ReviewText: good grill very hard to put tank in  a lot of very sharp edges i would think weber would not finish a product like this  too much stainless steel
Results.Title: grills pretty good

Results.ReviewText: After much research, decided on Weber because everyone else was comparing themselves to Weber.  Assembly took about 3 hours and was not too tough.  One of the grilling grates was damaged in shipping.  Customer support sent me replacement grates(2) within 3 days of my request.
Results.Title: Grate support

Results.ReviewText: I bought the Spirit E-210 Gas Grill just over a month ago. It worked great at the beginning, but the ignition button no longer works.
Results.Title: Started out great

Results.ReviewText: I purchased this grill as an end-of-season clearance item, and it looks very promising.  Construction is good, and there are some nice design features.  It is significantly different than the old grill it is replacing (mostly for the better, but unsure about some).  There were a few hiccups during the assembly process, which is fairly involved, mostly from tolerance buildup (you have to adjust earlier assemblies to get later assemblies to work correctly).  We have not tried it yet since it appears winter is upon us early, but I am looking forward to some good steaks.  Won't know about the "performance" rating until then.  The fold-down sides are a great feature during storage and the enclosed LP tank with fill gauge looks very promising.
Results.Title: Well constructed and nice design features

Results.ReviewText: Just right for me.  S is just right; not too big and not too small.  Cooks ideally.  Not a lot of whistles/bells/frills.  It's a no-nonsense grill for a down-to-earth griller.
Results.Title: Perfect!

Results.ReviewText: Weber is by far the very best in Customer service and warranty coverage. Anytime I have called I get a person based in the US that knows grills. They will promptly without question replace parts under warranty.  They have the best warranty coverage in the market.
Results.Title: Response to warranty

Results.ReviewText: I'm very satisfied with the quality of the grill and the manufacturer warranty.
Results.Title: Warranty parts repair

Results.ReviewText:
First effort at turkey on a rotisserie was a phenomenal success.
Heat was easily maintained for 3 1/2 hours with periodic basting
requiring lid to be opened.
Results.Title: excellent construction and easy to assmble

Results.ReviewText: I have used my new grill many times since I purchased it about 2 months ago.  Works great.  I read reviews before I bought it that said this model grill had trouble getting hot enough to sear a thick steak.  I have had NO problem like that.  It works just like my old 3-burner Weber that I used for over 30 years.
Results.Title: Works just like you would expect a Weber to work.

Results.ReviewText:
Food is grilled evenly 
Best grill we’ve ever owned
Easy cleaning 
Propane tank metering system is fantastic
Results.Title: Great features

Results.ReviewText: I was in need of a new grill and this one met my requirements

Results.ReviewText: I have this grill about 18 months and love it. Great heat for a 2 burner grill. Had a gas smell. Found the burner manifold leaking, called customer service and explained what I had found. Had a new manifold with in a week, no charge.
Results.Title: Great heat

Results.ReviewText: Very nice effective small grill.  Heats up quickly grates are easy to keep clean.
Results.Title: Good Deal

Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill from Home Depot 3 years ago and since then i have had to replace the cooking grates twice due to extreme rust, the flavor bars once due to rust, the regulator and hose once due to leaking and the igniter stops clicking at times.  I previously had a Weber Genesis Silver that i had for over 13 years and never had these issues.  The only reason that i replaced it with this one is the manifold stopped working and at the time was difficult to find a replacement.  Found one on Ebay and it worked for a year and then stopped working.  These new grills/part must be made in China or something, because they don't seem to last at all.
Results.Title: Rust Bucket

Results.ReviewText: This is the second Weber gas grill I've bought. I had my original grill for 20 years and I gave it to my step son to use. I really like this new grill! It's made with good quality! I cook on this grill at least 4-5 nights a week. I'd never buy another brand of grill but Weber.
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: I have wanted a Weber grill for a while and found a great deal on an assembled grill.   We love it as it cooks easily with good control
Results.Title: Sturdy grill

Results.ReviewText: I've had my grill a little over a month.  So far I love it.  It heats up fast, gets really hot and does a nice job searing meat.  I really like that the shelves fold down on both sides.  Also like that the tank is hidden behind the door.   The only thing I don't like is how loud/hard the lid closes.  I've seen rubber stopper gaskets on other Weber grills. I wish this one had those.
Results.Title: Great Grill - wish it had rubber cushions on lid

Results.ReviewText:
I love it! The burners light instantaneously, are very quiet, and their temperature is easy to control. The food residue collects nicely in the pan below which I have fitted with an aluminum dish. The folding sides enable the grill to be stored in a fairly small space.
I would certainly recommend this grill for anyone who does not have to cook a large amount of food at one time.
Results.Title: Performance

Results.ReviewText: I replaced my much worn Spirit with a new one.  I chose that over the newer model Spirit 2 because I like the fold-down side shelves.
Results.Title: I am a Weber guy.

Results.ReviewText: Our first Weber gas grill.  Perfect size for us (two retirees lol).  Nice that it has trays on  both sides.  We ran into an issue and received EXCELLENT customer service from Weber.
Results.Title: great smaller grill

Results.ReviewText: I love this little grill does a great job and absolutely fun to use
Results.Title: Good grill

Results.ReviewText: Warranty as posted in stores very misleading. Leads you to believe that product and parts are warranted for 10 years. Owners manual states different
Results.Title: Good grill but warranty misleading in stores

Results.ReviewText: I am very pleased with the heating and the quality of the grill! I like the propane meter. And the cast aluminum fire box.
Results.Title: The heating is much better then The Cheep grills!

I wanted to be sure I would get the cast iron searing effect when grilling. Another similar grill I was considering came with a stainless steel grills, which wouldn’t had performed to my expectations. I am really glad I decided to buy this grill. The performance far exceeds my expectations.
Results.Title: Great performance!

Results.ReviewText: Only brand I will ever buy.  Learned through experience and I'm 68 years old.
Results.Title: Very good grill for limited space

Results.ReviewText: I bought this about 3 weeks ago.  It is the best gas grill that I have ever used.  I still have to learn how to cook on it because it performs differently than my last grill.

Results.ReviewText: I’ve sold Weber Grills for years at ACE Hardware, so am familiar with their outstanding quality, benefits, and incredible 10 year warranty.  My new E-210 is perfect for our new townhouse patio and can easily grill a large brisket!  Best grill I’ve ever owned.
Results.Title: Best Grill I’ve owned!

Results.ReviewText: Originally I was angling for a Spirit II-E210, but found a close out price on this E-210.  The Spirit E-210 has four castoring wheels, so it can be wheeled around without having to remove the cover.  Very easy to push back under the eaves of my deck.  Both side tables fold down--another plus for storage.  Ignition is instant and no-nonsense.  The BBQ quickly comes up to temperature.  Grilling is a breeze, with the best results I've ever seen.  Also, the pedestal is enclosed, reducing weather exposure to the propane tank.  Very pleased with this BBQ grill.  Nice build quality.
Results.Title: Castoring wheels a plus

Results.ReviewText: I use my grill 3-4 times a week --- pretty much every week. My original Spirit was so good that when I added a second grill I decided to get the same kind. I haven't been disappointed.
Results.Title: My second one

Results.ReviewText: It’s was easy to operate & style is appealing. I bought grilling pads so it a easy clean up.
Results.Title: It’s just the right size.

Results.ReviewText: We have had this a month and used it five times.  So far it fits our needs perfectly.  If it lasts as. it should it will have been an excellent purchase.
Results.Title: Grill

Results.ReviewText: Love our new grill!  Easy to clean and cooks evenly. Also like theLP tank being inside of cabinet.
Results.Title: Best Grill I have ever owned.

Results.ReviewText: Love this grill, heats up fast and grills steak very nicely. We really like the feauture of both side tables fold down to be compact for storing.
Results.Title: Perfect for Two!

Results.ReviewText: This grill works great, the only issue I have is it doesn't get as hot as I would have liked. I think that has to do more with me going from a 3-burner to a 2-burner due to having a smaller patio. I BBQ 2-3x a week, and in the two weeks of owning the grill I have made ribs, burgers, and steaks with no issues. To sear I suggest just letting it get super hot and put it right on soon as you can, which worked well. The grill also is easy to clean up.
Results.Title: Great grill for smaller spaces

Results.ReviewText: We've been using our Weber Spirit E-210 Gas Grill for over 6 years and should get 6 more fairly easy. The outside body, stainless side shelves, and the inside propane area looks relatively new. We are nearing the time to replace the cast iron grates, maybe one more year.  At that time we will replace the flavor bars. They are not showing signs of burning through but it will be time for a fresh set. With all the use this grill gets through the winter, spring, summer, and fall this is more than expected. The grill is stored outside and a cover is used when the grill is not in use. Grill is great for searing steaks etc., it gets to a 600 plus in the summer and is fairly easy to get to 500+ in the winter. The only way to cook low and slow is offset cooking (using one burner only, on low, and cooking on the opposite side). Still starts on the first turn 99 percent of the time.
Results.Title: Great Gas Grill

Results.ReviewText: After looking at several grills--we decided the Weber E-210 Gas Grill  was for Us.  Our Grandson enjoys a Grilled Steak every Wednesday Evening When he visits us and our new Weber Grill does a "perfect steak" for him.  Thank you for making all of us happy!
Results.Title: Fine grill

Results.ReviewText: I bought this cause i was tired of grilling inside the house.  I love the expensive look. I also purchased the cover and both look great in my back yard.
Results.Title: The best grill for a small family

Results.ReviewText:
Lots of cooking power in a rather compact grill.  And the service behind Weber Grills is first class.  After my first tank of LP gas was finished up, I did a tank swap at the local grocery store.  The regulator was hissing gas and I thought it was the hose, so I purchased a new one from Weber.  The new regulator/hose did the same thing.  I called Weber and she immediately knew the problem was not the regulator/hose, rather the o-ring fitting on the recycled tank.  Sure enough I swapped the tank and problem was solved.  Weber let me return the 2nd regulator/hose for full credit.  
The customer service help line was extremely helpful.  Once I realized the potentially dangerous fault was with the LP Gas tank refiller, Weber went above and beyond to assist.

A superb product, stellar customer service and primo cooking!
Results.Title: Tasty Grilling!

Results.ReviewText: Had no idea how good this product is. Glad I bought it.
Results.Title: Fantastic grill

Results.ReviewText: We are very pleased with our purchase. Cooks evenly after fast warm up.
Results.Title: Cooks fast and evenly.

Results.ReviewText:
Cooks evenly and the grates clean fairly easy.
Weber backs their warranty.
Results.Title: Great Mid size Grill

Results.ReviewText: I see with dissolution how the new things instead of improving them get worse, I had the weber grills at a very high point but I see that they already got the same as the other cheap brands, I have two weber Genesis E-330 and I just  buy a Spirit 210 and I see with disappointment that the lid is a thinner sheet and has no lining inside to better retain the heat, inside down the burners does not have any heat deflector plate, I had to buy 2  Weber 310 plates and adapt them for better heat performance, I will even have to buy a galvanized sheet to make a lining inside the lid, even the grates have very large separators so that in the center of the 2 grates there is a very large opening, I had to grind that parts so that they would be closer to the center and remain of a uniform separation to how the gtates are built, For my next purchase I will have what  and make a more detailed comparison, because I lost faith to the Weber and if I buy another I will look for a late model because I see that the new models are already cheap made.
Results.Title: Desappointed

Results.ReviewText: I purchased this grill mainly in hopes that it would outlast the charbroil grill it is replacing. Time will tell on that score and I could very well update my rating. I am pleased with the evenness of heat distribution which was lacking on my previous grill. I am also experiencing less flare ups. I thought the price was a little steep at the time but I am having a better feeling that. Like I said time will tell.
Results.Title: even heat

Results.ReviewText: I bought the grill to augment my pellet grill that takes extra time to bring up to temperature for griiling.  Had a Weber for 30 years so my choice was simple.  The only issue I had was understanding how to achieve high temp. After starting,  I turned burner knob counterclockwise like you would turn anything to get more flow.  Found after calling Weber my mistake that it's at full flow when at startup.  Now all is good & thankful I chose Weber.
Results.Title: Fast simple reliable operation

Results.ReviewText: I messed around with a cheap grill for years, I’m so glad to have one that is actually doing what a grill should
Results.Title: Finally, a decent grill

Results.ReviewText: I purchased my Weber 2 months ago and couldn’t be happier. I looked into other grills and the reviews were average at best, until I looked at Weber, and they were all very high ratings. I can see why! GREAT GRILL!!!
Results.Title: High Quality

Results.ReviewText: Buying a grill can be an anxious and confusing purchase. Getting smaller due to space and present needs presents worry. Price is important as small gas grills are all over the place. For us the Spirit E-210 calmed all those fears and after assembly and use we couldn't be happier. Hats off to Weber engineers for design, operation, and packaging.
Results.Title: The Best Gets Better

Results.ReviewText: Holds heat wellwould recommend to everyone love the grill
Results.Title: Quality

Results.ReviewText: Especially fine and easy assembling and instructions.
Results.Title: All great

Results.ReviewText: I have been a Weber fan for 20 years or more.  They are reliable and never rust.  The only drawback on this newer model is the location of the gas tank.  It seems all the grills now have the tank inside under the burners.  As a mature woman it takes all my strength to place the grill on the hook as I can't get leverage. Aesthetically it looks better but practically it was much easier when the tank was mounted outside.

Results.ReviewText: This grill does all that you would ever expect from a grill and without breaking your budget.  Plus, WEBER backs up their products, particularly if you have a part, like I did, when my "flame deflectors" wore out prematurely.  They shipped out to me a new set, no ????s asked, and I had them within 2-3 days.  Once they arrived, I was back in business without "burning" my hamburger patties, thanks to the "new" flame deflectors sent out to me from Weber.  Thanks Weber!!!!!

Results.ReviewText: I use this grill 5 days a week all year long. It is handy easy to clean and operationally sound. The only team that has been a weakness is the knobs. The design has a push to turn and only has plastic with no insert for the knobs. This results in stripping the knobs, even with careful use, as the plastic cannot take the torque over time.
Results.Title: Good operation

Results.ReviewText: I replaced my former 15 year old Weber Grill with the Spirit 210 since my old grill was just too large for my family. My former grill was still functioning and is now with a new family.
Results.Title: Very Durable

Results.ReviewText: The grill is as good as expected. I really like the Weber App. I have used it for recipes as well as advice on grilling times, direct, indirect heat.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: We are huge Weber fans, just retired our 15 year old Weber  We decided to purchase a smaller grill and it works great. Perfect size for 2 people but also enough space when we have company!
Results.Title: Happy Grill!!!

Results.ReviewText: I made every burger for the concession stand for my son's football team. An entire seasons worth. Absolutely no problems. I had to empty the grease pan multiple times. I was very impressed with this little guy. I really like the ease of cleaning with the removable tray under the burners.
Results.Title: I love my grill

Results.ReviewText: This grill is second to none! I love it! Very good quality!
Results.Title: Best grill ever

Results.ReviewText: Our former grill was rusting out and not working well Five years we bought a Weber Grill in Canada and we love it, it is just like new 5 years later, so it was an easy choice to buy a Weber for our 2nd home. It is  just a two burner but suits us fine and does all our bar be cuing to perfection
Results.Title: PERFECT GRILL FOR OUR FLORIDA HOME

Results.ReviewText: Never knew how much I loved grilling until owning this Weber Grill. So very easy to use, reliable, food taste great, and great quality. I am looking forward to using this grill for many years.
Results.Title: Love this fabulous grill

Foods cook faster, we don't have as many problems with foods sticking, we rarely experience flareups and the gauge on the propane tank is a plus. Finally, we don't have to worry about running out of gas while cooking and playing the guessing game.

Results.ReviewText: The best money I ever spent, quality made and will last for years.  You won't be disappointed.

Results.ReviewText: I’m very happy with the grill, I even had an issue the first week and the company Sent me some replacement parts when they really didn’t have to. I will only buy Webber in the future!

Results.ReviewText: Good buy is all that needs to be said again and again
Results.Title: Great

Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill in September to replace a much larger grill I had for some time. This grill is small (2 burner) but I love it so far - have had much greater success grilling on this than my large older grill. It heats up fast and evenly. Would highly recommend it! The only difficult thing for me was hanging a heavy LP tank on the hook inside the cabinet so it would register on the LP tank level gauge.
Results.Title: I love my new little Weber grill!!

Results.ReviewText: Weber is the only grill I own, 3 charcoal, 2 lp gas nothing beats how they hold up and a warranty better than everything out there. So far this one is out of the same mold. Bought at a end of season clearance event at my local HD  $150.00 off and assembled sealed the deal for me.

I'm still learning, so bear with me, but I made the best burgers and the best pork chops one could ask for.  Now my next go round is going to be chicken.  I love this grill. It's easy to start and easy to clean.

46110001.Name: Spirit E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
